repos.json.content:
{
  "_doc": "coding workflow runner 仓库配置表（C4）：一行一个仓库。runner 判卷代码只从默认仓（cecelia）clone 读。enabled=false 的仓库即使列进 CODING_WF_REPOS 也不启用。required_checks 是登记口径（gh api .../branches/main/protection 只读核实），运行时仍以 GitHub 分支保护+规则集为准。production_re 是正则片段，按 | 拼接（活动层判碰生产用 本仓 ∪ 默认仓）。prechecks 是 lib/ci-precheck.mjs 的预检清单名；rules_prompt 是注入各提示词 {{REPO_RULES}} 的本仓规矩（C6）。",
  "repos": [
    {
      "key": "cecelia",
      "default": true,
      "enabled": true,
      "slug": "perfectuser21/cecelia",
      "origin": "https://github.com/perfectuser21/cecelia.git",
      "aliases": ["cecelia"],
      "clone": "~/perfect21/cecelia-cw-runner",
      "worktree_base": "~/worktrees/cecelia-cw",
      "state_ns": "",
      "required_checks": ["ci-passed", "Harness V5 Gate Passed", "Smoke Glob Runner Passed"],
      "base_fresh_check": "lint-base-fresh",
      "install": ["npm", "ci", "--legacy-peer-deps", "--ignore-scripts"],
      "qa_smoke": {
        "dir": "packages/brain/scripts/smoke",
        "allowlist": "packages/quality/smoke-allowlist.txt",
        "write_targets": "packages/quality/smoke-write-targets.txt"
      },
      "version_fragment": { "src_re": "^packages/brain/src/", "dir": "changes" },
      "preview": { "type": "brain_preview", "base_repo": "cecelia" },
      "production_re": [":5221\\b", "\\b(?:localhost|127\\.0\\.0\\.1)\\s+5221\\b", "100\\.79\\.41\\.61", "\\bus-vps\\b"],
      "automerge": true,
      "prechecks": "cecelia",
      "rules_prompt": "prompts/repo-rules/cecelia.md"
    },
    {
      "key": "zenithjoy-workspace",
      "default": false,
      "enabled": true,
      "_note": "第一阶段：C7 已开闸（runner 认领、Brain 无头 zenithjoy 编码单改投 coding_workflow）；QA 走 local（不起预览），回归 smoke 不固化；紧急关闸 = plist 设 CODING_WF_REPOS=cecelia 或本行 enabled=false。合入 main 会经 pilot-release-verification → deploy-phone-adb-controller 自动部署生产 mmv/xian-m4 手机控制器，所以 automerge=false（已批准→Bark→人工合并）。38.23.47.81 是 MMV（US Mac M4）公网 IP，不是 zenithjoy 生产，不进 production_re。",
      "slug": "perfectuser21/zenithjoy-workspace",
      "origin": "https://github.com/perfectuser21/zenithjoy-workspace.git",
      "aliases": ["zenithjoy", "zenithjoy-workspace"],
      "clone": "~/perfect21/zenithjoy-cw-runner",
      "worktree_base": "~/worktrees/zenithjoy-cw",
      "state_ns": "zenithjoy-workspace",
      "required_checks": [
        "L4 E2E Gate Passed",
        "L4 Runtime Gate Passed",
        "Integration Gate Passed",
        "L2 Consistency Gate Passed",
        "WeChat CS Gate Passed",
        "Smoke Glob Runner",
        "Smoke Glob Gate Passed",
        "Core Regression Gate Passed",
        "Line02 Lead Gate Passed",
        "Orphan E2E Gate Passed",
        "L3 Code Gate Passed",
        "Android CI Gate Passed"
      ],
      "base_fresh_check": null,
      "install": ["npm", "ci", "--ignore-scripts"],
      "qa_smoke": null,
      "version_fragment": null,
      "preview": { "type": "local" },
      "production_re": [":5200\\b", "100\\.86\\.118\\.99", "\\bhk-vps\\b"],
      "automerge": false,
      "prechecks": "zenithjoy",
      "rules_prompt": "prompts/repo-rules/zenithjoy.md"
    },
    {
      "key": "zenithjoy-skills",
      "default": false,
      "enabled": true,
      "slug": "perfectuser21/zenithjoy-skills",
      "origin": "https://github.com/perfectuser21/zenithjoy-skills.git",
      "aliases": [
        "zenithjoy-skills"
      ],
      "clone": "~/perfect21/zenithjoy-skills-cw-runner",
      "worktree_base": "~/worktrees/zenithjoy-skills-cw",
      "state_ns": "zenithjoy-skills",
      "required_checks": [
        "lint-skills"
      ],
      "base_fresh_check": null,
      "install": [
        "python3",
        "--version"
      ],
      "qa_smoke": null,
      "version_fragment": null,
      "preview": {
        "type": "local"
      },
      "production_re": [
        ":5200\\b",
        "100\\.86\\.118\\.99",
        "\\bhk-vps\\b",
        "\\b(?:mmv|xian-m4)\\b",
        "\\badb\\b"
      ],
      "automerge": false,
      "prechecks": "skills",
      "rules_prompt": "prompts/repo-rules/skills.md"
    }
  ]
}
